summary: A collector-car trade paper: five columns where every ad is a greyscale photo over a justified liner with a bold caps lead. Black reverse category bars, a ruled masthead box, and one large framed display ad.

frame.masthead: Ruled box: script-and-car logo, CLASSIFIEDS in heavy serif caps, contact line, italic small print.

headers.notes: Bold condensed caps, repeated at the top of each column.

units.example: FORD 1931, MODEL A TUDOR style, runs great... Phone (705) 879-9986, Bobcaygeon, ON. 9~11p
units.notes: Column-wide photo; lead is MAKE YEAR, MODEL in bold caps; ends with town and an issue-run code (9~11p).

units.example: Old Is New Again / VEHICLES WANTED!
units.notes: Oval logo, black bar with white italic caps headline, condensed bold phone line.

notes: Photos are what define this family; the generator needs an image slot per unit.
